verses.original: וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’el- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS foi Moisés, e falou estas palavras a todo o Israel,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם בֶּן־ מֵאָה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל ע֖וֹד לָצֵ֣את וְלָב֑וֹא וַֽיהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ben- mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ’ā·nō·ḵî hay·yō·wm lō- ’ū·ḵal ‘ō·wḏ lā·ṣêṯ wə·lā·ḇō·w Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’ê·lay lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên haz·zeh
verses.literal: he said to them I am now a hundred and twenty years old . . . I am no longer able to come and go and the LORD has said to me You shall not cross the Jordan
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Da idade de cento e vinte anos sou eu hoje; já não poderei mais sair e entrar; além disto o SENHOR me disse: Não passarás o Jordão.

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ ה֣וּא׀ עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֗יךָ הֽוּא־ יַשְׁמִ֞יד אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛לֶּה מִלְּפָנֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ ה֚וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hū ‘ō·ḇêr lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā hū- yaš·mîḏ ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wî·riš·tām yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ hū ‘ō·ḇêr lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you He will destroy these nations before you and you will dispossess them Joshua . . . will cross ahead of you as the LORD has said
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR teu Deus passará adiante de ti; ele destruirá estas nações de diante de ti, para que as possuas; Josué passará adiante de ti, como o SENHOR tem falado.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לְסִיח֥וֹן וּלְע֛וֹג מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וּלְאַרְצָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁמִ֖יד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh Yah·weh lā·hem ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·sî·ḥō·wn ū·lə·‘ō·wḡ mal·ḵê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ū·lə·’ar·ṣām ’ă·šer hiš·mîḏ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og the kings of the Amorites when He destroyed them along with their land
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR lhes fará como fez a Siom e a Ogue, reis dos amorreus, e à sua terra, os quais destruiu.

verses.original: וּנְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯā·nām Yah·weh lip̄·nê·ḵem wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem lā·hem kə·ḵāl- ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: The LORD will deliver them over to you and you must do to them exactly as . . . I have commanded you
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, o SENHOR vo-los der diante de vós, então com eles fareis conforme a todo o mandamento que vos tenho ordenado.

verses.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֥וּ וְאַל־ תַּעַרְצ֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יַעַזְבֶֽךָּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥiz·qū wə·’im·ṣū ’al- tî·rə·’ū wə·’al- ta·‘ar·ṣū mip·pə·nê·hem kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hū ha·hō·lêḵ ‘im·māḵ lō yar·pə·ḵā wə·lō ya·‘az·ḇe·kā
verses.literal: Be strong and courageous do not be afraid . . . or terrified of them for it is the LORD your God who goes with you He will never leave you nor forsake you
verses.literalPt: Esforçai-vos, e animai-vos; não temais, nem vos espanteis diante deles; porque o SENHOR teu Deus é o que vai contigo; não te deixará nem te desamparará.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לְעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥נָּה אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā mō·šeh lî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl yiś·rå̄·ʾēl ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·māṣ kî ’at·tāh tā·ḇō·w ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯām lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem wə·’at·tāh tan·ḥî·len·nāh ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel Be strong and courageous for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them and you shall give it to them as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: E chamou Moisés a Josué, e lhe disse aos olhos de todo o Israel: Esforça-te e anima-te; porque com este povo entrarás na terra que o SENHOR jurou a teus pais lhes dar; e tu os farás herdá-la.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֞ה ה֣וּא׀ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑ךָּ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א וְלֹ֥א תֵחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hū ha·hō·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā hū yih·yeh ‘im·māḵ lō yar·pə·ḵā wə·lō ya·‘az·ḇe·kā lō ṯî·rā wə·lō ṯê·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: The LORD Himself goes before you He will be with you He will never leave you nor forsake you Do not be afraid or discouraged
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR, pois, é aquele que vai adiante de ti; ele será contigo, não te deixará, nem te desamparará; não temas, nem te espantes.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֗הּ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הַנֹּ֣שְׂאִ֔ים אֶת־ אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ mō·šeh ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ way·yit·tə·nāh ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê lê·wî han·nō·śə·’îm ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ Yah·weh wə·’el- kāl- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests the sons of Levi who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD and to all the elders of Israel
verses.literalPt: E Moisés escreveu esta lei, e a deu aos sacerdotes, filhos de Levi, que levavam a arca da aliança do SENHOR, e a todos os anciãos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו מֹשֶׁ֖ה אוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים בְּמֹעֵ֛ד שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁמִטָּ֖ה בְּחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw mō·šeh ’ō·w·ṯām lê·mōr miq·qêṣ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm bə·mō·‘êḏ šə·naṯ haš·šə·miṭ·ṭāh bə·ḥaḡ has·suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Moses - commanded them At the end of every seven years at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt during the Feast of Tabernacles
verses.literalPt: E ordenou-lhes Moisés, dizendo: Ao fim de cada sete anos, no tempo determinado do ano da remissão, na festa dos tabernáculos,

verses.original: בְּב֣וֹא כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֑ר תִּקְרָ֞א אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את נֶ֥גֶד כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇō·w ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl lê·rā·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥār tiq·rā ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ ne·ḡeḏ kāl- yiś·rā·’êl bə·’ā·zə·nê·hem
verses.literal: when all Israel . . . . . . comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel
verses.literalPt: Quando todo o Israel vier a comparecer perante o SENHOR teu Deus, no lugar que ele escolher, lerás esta lei diante de todo o Israel aos seus ouvidos.

verses.original: הַקְהֵ֣ל אֶת־ הָעָ֗ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְהַנָּשִׁים֙ וְהַטַּ֔ף וְגֵרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֨עַן יִשְׁמְע֜וּ וּלְמַ֣עַן יִלְמְד֗וּ וְיָֽרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָֽׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: haq·hêl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·han·nā·šîm wə·haṭ·ṭap̄ wə·ḡê·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā lə·ma·‘an yiš·mə·‘ū ū·lə·ma·‘an yil·mə·ḏū wə·yā·rə·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·šā·mə·rū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: Assemble the people men women children and the foreigners within your gates so that they may listen . . . and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law
verses.literalPt: Ajunta o povo, os homens e as mulheres, os meninos e os estrangeiros que estão dentro das tuas portas, para que ouçam e aprendam e temam ao SENHOR vosso Deus, e tenham cuidado de fazer todas as palavras desta lei;

verses.original: וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יָדְע֗וּ יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ וְלָ֣מְד֔וּ לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê·hem ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū yiš·mə·‘ū wə·lā·mə·ḏū lə·yir·’āh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem kāl- hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer ’at·tem ḥay·yîm ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God as . . . long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan . . . to possess
verses.literalPt: E que seus filhos, que não a souberem, ouçam e aprendam a temer ao SENHOR vosso Deus, todos os dias que viverdes sobre a terra a qual ides, passando o Jordão, para a possuir.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן קָרְב֣וּ יָמֶיךָ֮ לָמוּת֒ קְרָ֣א אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וַאֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ מֹשֶׁה֙ וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh hên qā·rə·ḇū yā·me·ḵā lā·mūṯ qə·rā ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wa·’ă·ṣaw·wen·nū way·yê·leḵ mō·šeh wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Behold the time of your death is near Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting so that I may commission him So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Eis que os teus dias são chegados, para que morras; chama a Josué, e apresentai-vos na tenda da congregação, para que eu lhe dê ordens. Assim foram Moisés e Josué, e se apresentaram na tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה בָּאֹ֖הֶל בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֑ן וַיַּעֲמֹ֛ד עַמּ֥וּד הֶעָנָ֖ן עַל־ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā Yah·weh bā·’ō·hel bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān ‘al- pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud and the cloud stood . . . over the entrance to the tent
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR apareceu na tenda, na coluna de nuvem; e a coluna de nuvem estava sobre a porta da tenda.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲזָבַ֕נִי וְהֵפֵר֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh hin·nə·ḵā šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wə·qām hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·zā·nāh ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê nê·ḵar- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hū ḇā- šām·māh bə·qir·bōw wa·‘ă·zā·ḇa·nî wə·hê·p̄êr ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’ă·šer kā·rat·tî ’it·tōw
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses You will soon rest with your fathers and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering . . . . . . They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Eis que dormirás com teus pais; e este povo se levantará, e prostituir-se-á indo após os deuses estranhos na terra, para cujo meio vai, e me deixará, e anulará a minha aliança que tenho feito com ele.

verses.original: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣י ב֣וֹ בַיּוֹם־ הַ֠הוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּ֞ים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤י מֵהֶם֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לֶֽאֱכֹ֔ל וּמְצָאֻ֛הוּ רָע֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְצָר֑וֹת וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הֲלֹ֗א עַ֣ל כִּֽי־ אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהַי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י מְצָא֖וּנִי הָרָע֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·rāh ’ap·pî ḇōw ḇay·yō·wm- ha·hū wa·‘ă·zaḇ·tîm wə·his·tar·tî p̄ā·nay mê·hem wə·hā·yāh le·’ĕ·ḵōl ū·mə·ṣā·’u·hū rā·‘ō·wṯ rab·bō·wṯ wə·ṣā·rō·wṯ wə·’ā·mar bay·yō·wm ha·hū hă·lō ‘al kî- ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hay bə·qir·bî mə·ṣā·’ū·nî hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: On that day My anger will burn against them and I will abandon them and hide My face from them so that they will be consumed and many troubles and afflictions will befall them On that day they will say Have not these disasters come upon us because . . . our God is no longer with us
verses.literalPt: Assim se acenderá a minha ira naquele dia contra ele, e desampará-lo-ei, e esconderei o meu rosto dele, para que seja devorado; e tantos males e angústias o alcançarão, que dirá naquele dia: Não me alcançaram estes males, porque o meu Deus não está no meio de mim?

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עַ֥ל כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י פָנָ֔ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî has·têr ’as·tîr pā·nay bay·yō·wm ha·hū ‘al kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh kî p̄ā·nāh ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm
verses.literal: And on that day I will surely hide . . . My face because of all the evil they have done . . . by turning to other gods
verses.literalPt: Esconderei, pois, totalmente o meu rosto naquele dia, por todo o mal que tiver feito, por se haverem tornado a outros deuses.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְלַמְּדָ֥הּ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣הּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּהְיֶה־ לִּ֜י הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לְעֵ֖ד בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kiṯ·ḇū lā·ḵem ’eṯ- haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ wə·lam·mə·ḏāh ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl śî·māh bə·p̄î·hem lə·ma·‘an tih·yeh- lî haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ lə·‘êḏ biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now therefore write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites . . . have them recite it so that it . . . may be a witness for Me against them . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, escrevei-vos este cântico, e ensinai-o aos filhos de Israel; ponde-o na sua boca, para que este cântico me seja por testemunha contra os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֲבִיאֶ֜נּוּ אֶֽל־ הָאֲדָמָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֗יו זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְאָכַ֥ל וְשָׂבַ֖ע וְדָשֵׁ֑ן וּפָנָ֞ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַעֲבָד֔וּם וְנִ֣אֲצ֔וּנִי וְהֵפֵ֖ר אֶת־ בְּרִיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ă·ḇî·’en·nū ’el- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯāw zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš wə·’ā·ḵal wə·śā·ḇa‘ wə·ḏā·šên ū·p̄ā·nāh ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏūm wə·ni·’ă·ṣū·nî wə·hê·p̄êr ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî
verses.literal: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers a land flowing with milk and honey they will eat their fill and prosper Then they will turn to other gods and worship them and they will reject Me and break My covenant
verses.literalPt: Porque introduzirei o meu povo na terra que jurei a seus pais, que mana leite e mel; e comerá, e se fartará, e se engordará; então se tornará a outros deuses, e os servirá, e me irritarão, e anularão a minha aliança.

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָה כִּֽי־ תִמְצֶ֨אןָ אֹת֜וֹ רָע֣וֹת רַבּוֹת֮ וְצָרוֹת֒ וְ֠עָנְתָה הַשִּׁירָ֨ה הַזֹּ֤את לְפָנָיו֙ לְעֵ֔ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ כִּ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת־ יִצְר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא עֹשֶׂה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֲבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבָּֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ṯim·ṣe·nā ’ō·ṯōw rā·‘ō·wṯ rab·bō·wṯ wə·ṣā·rō·wṯ wə·‘ā·nə·ṯāh haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ lə·p̄ā·nāw lə·‘êḏ kî lō ṯiš·šā·ḵaḥ mip·pî zar·‘ōw kî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- yiṣ·rōw ’ă·šer hū ‘ō·śeh hay·yō·wm bə·ṭe·rem ’ă·ḇî·’en·nū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·bā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them this song will testify . . . against them because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants For I know their inclination - . . . . . . even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them
verses.literalPt: E será que, quando o alcançarem muitos males e angústias, então este cântico responderá contra ele por testemunha, pois não será esquecido da boca de sua descendência; porquanto conheço a sua boa imaginação, o que ele faz hoje, antes que o introduza na terra que tenho jurado.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיְלַמְּדָ֖הּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ mō·šeh ’eṯ- haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·lam·mə·ḏāh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So that very day Moses wrote down this song and taught it to the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim Moisés escreveu este cântico naquele dia, e o ensinou aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן וַיֹּאמֶר֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶֽאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבִיא֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לָהֶ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn way·yō·mer ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·māṣ kî ’at·tāh tā·ḇî ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tî lā·hem wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said Be strong and courageous for you will bring the Israelites . . . into the land that I swore to give them and I will be with you
verses.literalPt: E ordenou a Josué, filho de Num, e disse: Esforça-te e anima-te; porque tu introduzirás os filhos de Israel na terra que lhes jurei; e eu serei contigo.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְתֹּ֛ב אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־ הַזֹּ֖את עַל־ סֵ֑פֶר עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·wṯ mō·šeh liḵ·tōḇ ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh- haz·zōṯ ‘al- sê·p̄er ‘aḏ tum·mām
verses.literal: When Moses had finished writing in a book the words of this . . . law . . . from beginning to end
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, acabando Moisés de escrever num livro, todas as palavras desta lei,

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹ֥שְׂאֵ֛י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw mō·šeh ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: he gave this command to . . . the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Deu ordem aos levitas, que levavam a arca da aliança do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: לָקֹ֗חַ אֵ֣ת סֵ֤פֶר הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וְשַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔וֹ מִצַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָֽיָה־ שָׁ֥ם בְּךָ֖ לְעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: lā·qō·aḥ ’êṯ sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zeh wə·śam·tem ’ō·ṯōw miṣ·ṣaḏ ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·hā·yāh- šām bə·ḵā lə·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God so that it may remain there as a witness against you
verses.literalPt: Tomai este livro da lei, e ponde-o ao lado da arca da aliança do SENHOR vosso Deus, para que ali esteja por testemunha contra ti.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶֽת־ מֶרְיְךָ֔ וְאֶֽת־ עָרְפְּךָ֖ הַקָּשֶׁ֑ה הֵ֣ן בְּעוֹדֶנִּי֩ חַ֨י עִמָּכֶ֜ם הַיּ֗וֹם מַמְרִ֤ים הֱיִתֶם֙ עִם־ יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאַ֖ף כִּי־ אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·nō·ḵî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- mer·yə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ‘ā·rə·pə·ḵā haq·qā·šeh hên bə·‘ō·w·ḏen·nî ḥay ‘im·mā·ḵem hay·yō·wm mam·rîm hĕ·yi·ṯem ‘im- Yah·weh wə·’ap̄ kî- ’a·ḥă·rê mō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are . . . If you are already . . . rebelling against the LORD . . . while I am still alive how much more . . . will you rebel after my death
verses.literalPt: Porque conheço a tua rebelião e a tua dura cerviz; eis que, vivendo eu ainda hoje convosco, rebeldes fostes contra o SENHOR; e quanto mais depois da minha morte?

verses.original: הַקְהִ֧ילוּ אֵלַ֛י אֶת־ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֔ם אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: haq·hî·lū ’ê·lay ’eṯ- kāl- ziq·nê šiḇ·ṭê·ḵem wə·šō·ṭə·rê·ḵem wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ḇə·’ā·zə·nê·hem ’êṯ had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh bām ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them
verses.literalPt: Ajuntai perante mim todos os anciãos das vossas tribos, e vossos oficiais, e aos seus ouvidos falarei estas palavras, e contra eles por testemunhas tomarei o céu e a terra.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אַחֲרֵ֤י מוֹתִי֙ כִּֽי־ הַשְׁחֵ֣ת תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־ הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֨את אֶתְכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעָה֙ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֔ים כִּֽי־ תַעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת־ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְהַכְעִיס֖וֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’a·ḥă·rê mō·w·ṯî kî- haš·ḥêṯ taš·ḥi·ṯūn wə·sar·tem min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·qā·rāṯ ’eṯ·ḵem hā·rā·‘āh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm kî- ṯa·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·haḵ·‘î·sōw bə·ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·ḵem
verses.literal: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt . . . and turn from the path I have commanded you And in the days to come disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sei que depois da minha morte certamente vos corrompereis, e vos desviareis do caminho que vos ordenei; então este mal vos alcançará nos últimos dias, quando fizerdes mal aos olhos do SENHOR, para o provocar à ira com a obra das vossas mãos.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּאָזְנֵי֙ כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh bə·’ā·zə·nê kāl- qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- diḇ·rê haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ ‘aḏ tum·mām
verses.literal: Then Moses . . . recited aloud to the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song from beginning to end
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés falou as palavras deste cântico aos ouvidos de toda a congregação de Israel, até se acabarem.
